sources.games: 606 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 49.7%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py pangolier.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Black King Bar, Pipe of Insight (not in his games).
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 120 (Swashbuckle, Shield Crash, Roll Up, Rolling Thunder), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-20: no Spirit Vessel for offlaners against heavy healing (a support's item); Linken's Sphere for Queen of Pain, Puck, Void Spirit and Storm Spirit against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not Slark; Axe levels Battle Hunger second; Templar Assassin keeps Meld > Psi Blades > Refraction.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 46% (2), null_talisman 22% (4), magic_wand 85% (4), pers 73% (7), mage_slayer 64% (11), power_treads 71% (12), diffusal_blade 71% (14), aghanims_shard 83% (23), ultimate_scepter 83% (25), basher 39% (32), soul_booster 32% (33), octarine_core 29% (35).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 75.0%+: 30:00 16000 (164 games, 75.6%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

skills.basis: 606 games since 7.41: maxed pangolier_swashbuckle > pangolier_shield_crash > pangolier_lucky_shot 321 (win 47.4%), pangolier_swashbuckle > pangolier_lucky_shot > pangolier_shield_crash 241 (win 54.4%), pangolier_shield_crash > pangolier_swashbuckle > pangolier_lucky_shot 26 (win 61.5%); talents 10: +3 Lucky Shot Armor Reduction 465/606 (48.8%), +200 Swashbuckle Slash Range 141/606 (52.5%); 15: +125 Shield Crash Barrier 317/575 (52.1%), -2s Swashbuckle Cooldown 258/575 (50.8%); 20: -1.5s Shield Crash Cooldown 336/400 (61.0%), +2s Rolling Thunder Duration 64/400 (45.3%); 25: +20% Attack Damage as Swashbuckle Damage 87/156 (66.7%), -15s Rolling Thunder Cooldown 69/156 (69.6%).

suppress.magic: Valve 7.41f: Rolling Thunder and Roll Up give him debuff immunity and 80% magic resistance; high-rank Pangoliers buy no Pipe of Insight or BKB (none among their items against 3+ magic heroes, 47 games).
